meta.title: The Last Seed
meta.audience: Viewers who appreciate historical folktales and emotionally grounded stories about resilience.
meta.intent: After watching, the audience should feel the profound weight of patience and understand that small acts of hope shape the future.

style.prefix: Grounded Ethiopian highland realism, 35mm film still, natural lighting, earthy color palette, cinematic composition

characters.alemu: Alemu, a 70-year-old Ethiopian farmer with deeply weathered dark skin, etched lines around calm eyes, close-cropped grey hair and beard, wearing a worn white cotton shamma and dark earth-toned gabi.
characters.villagers: A group of sun-worn Ethiopian adults in dusty cotton garments, holding a clay water pot with skeptical expressions.
characters.girl: An 8-year-old Ethiopian girl with traditional braided hairstyle, wearing a light cotton dress with subtle border trim.

references.description: Alemu squatting in a dry field, holding a single seed in his calloused hand, wearing a traditional shamma and gabi.
A young girl with traditional braids crouching near a green sprout in dry earth, smiling gently.
A group of four worried villagers interacting in a parched landscape, one holding an empty clay pot.
A lush mature highland tree providing shade over villagers sitting with woven harvest baskets in emerald green fields.
An aerial view of an isolated Ethiopian highland village surrounded by cracked ochre fields and empty dry paths.

narration.text_en: Long ago, in a village from which the sky had turned away, drought parched the land.
narration.text: ከብዙ ዘመን በፊት፣ ሰማይ ፊቱን ባዞረባት አንዲት መንደር፣ ድርቅ ምድሪቱን አደረቃት።

narration.text_en: And hope dried up like the river.
Yet the old farmer Alemu found one thing left inside his empty storehouse...
narration.text: አዛውንቱ ገበሬ አለሙ ግን፣ በባዶ ጎተራው ውስጥ አንድ ነገር አገኘ...

narration.text_en: You are going to sow that single seed? The earth doesn't have a drop of water!
narration.text: ይህችን አንዲት ዘር ልትተክል ነው? መሬቱ እኮ ጠብታ ውሃ የለውም!

narration.text_en: Yet if we do not sow it, what will grow tomorrow?
Though all others had surrendered, he buried his faith in the soil.
narration.text: ሁሉም ተስፋ ቢቆርጥም፣ እሱ ግን እምነቱን በአፈር ውስጥ ቀበረ።

narration.text_en: Days passed; nothing sprouted. Still, he did not stop waiting.
narration.text: ቀናት አለፉ፤ ምንም አልበቀለም። ነገር ግን እሱ መጠበቁን አላቆመም።

narration.text_en: And after many days, a tiny life emerged from the parched earth.
narration.text: ከብዙ ቀናት በኋላም፣ ከደረቀው መሬት ትንሽ ሕይወት ብቅ አለች።

narration.text_en: Years rolled by. The tiny shoot became a great tree, offering shade and fruit to the entire village.
narration.text: ዓመታት ነጎዱ። ትንሿ ቡቃያ ታላቅ ዛፍ ሆና፣ ጥላዋንና ፍሬዋን ለመንደሩ ሁሉ ሰጠች።

narration.text_en: A great shelter begins with a single tiny seed.
narration.text: ታላቅ ጥላ የሚጀምረው፣ ከአንዲት ትንሽ ዘር ነው።
